name: Cheesy Baked Pasta
summary: Pasta, jarred sauce, and cheddar baked in one dish. Five steps, no skill required.

ingredients.name: pasta sauce (Great Value or No Name)

instructions: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the package says. It finishes in the oven. Drain.
Return the pasta to the pot. Stir in both jars of sauce, the Italian seasoning, the garlic powder, and half the cheddar.
Spread into a 9×13-inch baking dish and scatter the rest of the cheddar on top.
Bake 20 minutes until the cheese is melted and the edges are bubbling. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

substitutions.substitute: gluten-free pasta (rice or corn based) in the same weight

glutenFree.notes: Most plain jarred tomato sauces are gluten-free, but check the label. Cheddar is naturally gluten-free.

budgetNotes: If there is room in the budget, brown 450 g of medium ground beef ($8.55) and stir it in with the sauce. That brings the total to about $16.40, so it no longer counts as an under-$15 recipe.
A can of white kidney beans ($1.50), drained and stirred in, adds protein and keeps the total under $10.
Undercooking the pasta before baking stops it going soft.
